title: hubHomeChatContext
responsibility: Lets a Home action open and close the shared Chief of Staff widget, optionally with Tracker context.

inputs.name: provideHomeCosChat.refreshAsk
inputs.description: Refreshes the open-ask list on demand when a question is opened.

outputs.name: provideHomeCosChat
outputs.description: Installs and returns one widget controller for this Home or native work view.

outputs.name: homeCosChat
outputs.description: Returns the nearest widget controller from Svelte context, or undefined outside its provider.
